The OSHA PSM threshold quantity for chlorine (CAS 7782-50-5) is 1,500 lb. A process holding that much chlorine or more is covered by the standard.

I checked this against the current text of 29 CFR 1910.119, Appendix A ("List of Highly Hazardous Chemicals, Toxics and Reactives"), which I downloaded from eCFR. The thresholds in that table are in pounds. The entry reads: Chlorine, 7782-50-5, 1500.

The same table lists these related chlorine compounds, each at 1,000 lb:
- Chlorine dioxide (10049-04-4)
- Chlorine pentafluoride (13637-63-3; eCFR spells it "Pentrafluoride")
- Chlorine trifluoride (7790-91-2)

No project files were changed. The downloaded copy of the regulation is at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-claude/7f32c98e-a938-56c1-bbe5-753958320d05/scratchpad/work/x098/psm.html.
